problem: piv_events.jsonl is a single append-only file that can span multiple trading dates (confirmed: 2026-08-23/24/25 in one file) with no built-in way to scope a report to exactly one session/date.
decision: Stamp every PivEvent with session_id/trading_date_et at emit time, and make report generation take an explicit trading_date_et filter, rather than restructuring on-disk storage into per-session directories. This preserves the append-only audit history (useful for cross-session investigation) while making single-session/date reports reliable.
why_not_a_directory_migration: results/runtime/<trading_date>/<session_id>/ was considered (and remains the PREFERRED target layout for a future task) but is a bigger, riskier change: every reader of config.state_dir (preflight, lifecycle_state.json, warmup_verification.json, session_readiness_state.json, latest_reconciliation.json, latest_session_report.json, the Telegram audit DB) would need path updates in the same change. Deferred -- see production_readiness_gaps.json PRG-04.

every_runtime_session_now_carries.trading_date_et: America/New_York calendar date, computed from the session start UTC timestamp
every_runtime_session_now_carries.runtime_start_utc: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of session construction
every_runtime_session_now_carries.runtime_sha: git rev-parse HEAD at session start, best-effort ('unknown' if git is unavailable -- never blocks startup)
every_runtime_session_now_carries.config_hash: sha256[:12] of (feed_mode, universe, entry_cutoff_et, eod_flatten_et, decision_path_enabled, paper_trading, real_capital) -- excludes secrets and paths

event_schema_additions.PivEvent.session_id: stamped by EventBus.emit if not already set by the caller
event_schema_additions.PivEvent.trading_date_et: stamped by EventBus.emit via events.trading_date_for(timestamp) if not already set
event_schema_additions.PivEvent.notification_class: stamped by EventBus.emit via events.notification_class_for(event, source) if not already set -- see notification_contract.json

reporting_changes.behavior: When trading_date_et is given, every count in the report is computed only over rows whose trading_date_et matches -- this is what prevents e.g. 2026-08-24 and 2026-08-25 activity from being silently summed. Omitting it preserves the old whole-file behavior for any existing caller.
reporting_changes.cli_wiring: talonx_piv/cli.py's `eod` command now reads session_identity.json (written by `start`) to recover the live session's own session_id/trading_date_et, and quant_funnel_report.json (written by SessionRunner at end of run) to fold in Part 3's funnel accounting.

backward_compatibility: A pre-Task69Q piv_events.jsonl has no session_id/trading_date_et fields on its old rows; build_session_report's trading_date_et filter simply excludes rows lacking a matching (i.e. any) trading_date_et field, so old data is invisible to a date-scoped report but remains fully readable by the unfiltered whole-file mode.
